item.title: What is (software) architecture
item.description:
What is software architecture? And is it needed?

I met Charity Majors at a conference recently and talked to her about her statement “architect is a bullshit role”. I am one of those that she refers to when she says ()“One of my favorite things in the world is when software architects come up to me and tell me how much they enjoyed my piece about how “software architect” is such a bullshit role at most companies.”) [https://bsky.app/profile/mipsytipsy.bsky.social/post/3lcqpqlkjpc2l]
